Text: A patient in shock is packaged and placed in a {{c1::supine}} position.
Back Extra: Distinguish: chest pain with no suspected injury earns a position of comfort instead.

Text: Whenever you grasp a stretcher or backboard, your hands should be {{c1::at least 10 inches (25 cm)}} apart.
Back Extra: Cue: insert each hand under the handle palm up with the thumb extended upward.
